title: 第11章 想让我杀谁？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“天啊，老爷是给了那新来的县令多少银子，才把他高兴成那样？”

“看那袋子，恐怕至少也得有百两吧。”

“这新来的县令，真的是皇子吗？皇子怎么会这么见钱眼开，活像一副没见过钱的样子。”

钱世康刚从正厅追出来，就撞见两名钱家的下人，在背后议论张宁。

闻言，他的脸色顿时一沉。

无知的下人，宁弟这哪是见钱眼开，分明就是在讽刺我们钱家小气呢。

可恶的钱荀，他肯定是害怕我跟宁弟走得太近，威胁到了他的家主之位，才故意羞辱宁弟。

真是可笑，我可是宁弟之夷吾，岂会把一个小小的钱家放在眼里？

心胸如此狭隘，钱家在你手中，又怎能不日渐衰落？

钱世康越想越气，猛地咆哮出声，“宁弟去哪了？你们刚才为什么不拦着他点？”

两名下人被吓得一哆嗦，颤颤巍巍地伸出手，指向大门的方向，“县令大人刚出去不久，而且……也没人让我们拦着他啊。”

“没用的东西。”钱世康狠狠瞪了两眼一眼，大步向外走去，“本公子回来再收拾你们。”

两名下人满脸无辜，我们这是招谁惹谁了？

但就在这时，一个一袭白衣，双手捂着胸口，神色略显惊慌的女人，快步走了过来。

钱世康一看到来人，脸上的怒容瞬间消失不见，露出温和的笑容，关切道：“嫂嫂何故惊慌？可是有什么人欺负你了？”

她正是钱世康口中守活寡的嫂嫂，宋泠。

钱世康虽然对宋泠觊觎已久，但在宋泠的面前，却从不敢造次。

“没，没人欺负我。”宋泠摇头，微微一笑，“就是方才在门前，遇到了个有些奇怪的人。”

“奇怪的人？”钱世康瞪眼，对两名下人怒斥道，“你们这些没用的废物，谁允许你们把什么人都放进来的？嫂嫂要是有个三长两短，我……”

“少，少爷，大少奶奶口中的人，会不会是那位新来的县令？”一个下人小心翼翼地说道。

钱世康想也不想道：“放屁，我宁弟怎么可能会是奇怪的人？”

“少，少爷，那位大人逢人就大喊，老爷给了他好多好多银两，举止是有些怪异……”另一名下人又道，“大少奶奶，那人身上是不是还有个挺大的布袋？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Oh my god, how much money did the master give the new county magistrate to make him so happy?"

"Look at that bag, I'm afraid it must be at least a hundred taels."

"Is this new magistrate really the prince? How can the prince be so blinded by money? It's as if he has never seen money before."

As soon as Qian Shikang chased him out of the main hall, he bumped into two servants of the Qian family, talking about Zhang Ning behind his back.

Hearing this, his face suddenly darkened.

Ignorant servant, Brother Ning is not blind to money, he is clearly mocking the stinginess of our Qian family.

Damn Qian Xun, he must be afraid that I would get too close to Ning Di and threaten his position as head of the family, so he deliberately humiliated Ning Di.

It's really ridiculous. I am Ning's brother Yiwu. How can I take a small Qian family seriously?

With such a narrow mind, how can the Qian family not decline day by day in your hands?

The more Qian Shikang thought about it, the angrier he became, and he roared loudly, "Where is Brother Ning? Why didn't you stop him just now?"

The two servants were frightened and trembled. They stretched out their hands tremblingly and pointed in the direction of the door, "The county magistrate just left not long ago, and... no one asked us to stop him."

"Useless things." Qian Shikang glared hard and strode out, "I will take care of you when I come back."

The two servants looked innocent. Who did we provoke?

But at this moment, a woman dressed in white, with her hands covering her chest and a slightly panicked look, walked over quickly.

As soon as Qian Shikang saw the person coming, the anger on his face disappeared in an instant, revealing a gentle smile, and asked with concern: "Why are you so panicked, sister-in-law? But who bullied you?"

She was Song Ling, Qian Shikang's widowed sister-in-law.

Although Qian Shikang had coveted Song Ling for a long time, he never dared to make mistakes in front of Song Ling.

"No, no one bullied me." Song Ling shook his head and smiled slightly, "I just met a strange person in front of the door."

"Weird people?" Qian Shikang glared and angrily yelled at the two servants, "You useless trash, who allowed you to let everyone in? If my sister-in-law has a problem, I..."

"Young Master, could the person the young lady is talking about be the new county magistrate?" a servant said cautiously.

Qian Shikang said without thinking: "Fart, how could my brother Ning be a strange person?"

"Young Master, that gentleman always yells when he meets someone. He gave him a lot of money, and his behavior is a little weird..." Another servant said again, "My eldest mistress, does that person have a big cloth bag on his body?"
